blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Serpentine

items.t: ALR frame for the feed's acreage ground (the rule book that actually governs most of this ground): the visible cards are dominated by farm and acreage parcels. On ALR parcels the ALC housing frame is one principal residence at a maximum of 500 m² plus at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha), with any secondary suite inside the principal residence, and subdivision of ALR land requires Agricultural Land Commission permission outside limited regulation exceptions — depositing a strata plan is a subdivision (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; ALCA s. 21(1)), so ALR ground cannot be stratified without ALC permission. Which feed parcels are actually in the ALR: Not verified — check parcel by parcel on ALC mapping; listing text is not an ALR determination.

Form B (for strata stock generally — this ground has none verified): Strata Property Act s. 59 — on a resale purchase the strata must provide a Form B Information Certificate stating strata fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, the CRF balance and a summary of the strata's insurance, with rules, budget, any Rental Disclosure Statement and the most recent depreciation report attached; provided within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page. It has no application to a freehold acreage parcel.

Depreciation reports and CRF (strata stock generally): since July 1, 2024, stratas with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years, no deferral by vote; and since November 1, 2023, stratas must contribute at least 10% of the operating fund to the CRF. Neither rule creates strata stock on this ground.

Short-term rentals (Surrey): under 90 consecutive days per patron; only the owner may host, the owner must live at the property as their primary residence, tenants cannot run one, and a business licence at $358 per year is required. On ALR parcels the ALC short-term accommodation limits in the first bullet govern instead.

What a duplex looks like in Serpentine

items.t: The usual duplex form: Surrey's urban duplex form class (individual duplex buildings on single fee-simple lots under the zoning of their day; the R6 Semi-Detached form created when the July 8, 2024 SSMUH changes replaced RF-SD) applies to non-ALR urban Surrey lots as a class.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in Serpentine

items.t: On ALR parcels the ALC housing frame is one principal residence at a maximum of 500 m² plus at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha), with any secondary suite inside the principal residence, and subdivision of ALR land requires Agricultural Land Commission permission outside limited regulation exceptions.

Zoning and SSMUH (Surrey): Surrey Zoning By-law No. 12000 governs. Surrey's zoning allows a maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop. Duplexes are the baseline form under that framework.
